title: Checking what automatic billing sent
summary: See what automatic billing generated and sent, and what needs checking.

steps.text: {title} lists the bills automatic billing generated and the emails it sent, and anything to check, such as a billing failure or an email waiting to go out. {unread} keeps the list to what is new; {ack} clears it.
You can also ask the assistant what automatic billing did, or to generate the invoices that are due. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
